about.lead: From the stages of Parc Astérix to Dubai with Franco Dragone, all the way to the lights of Las Vegas with Cirque du Soleil — an international career blending acrobatics, comedy and performance.
about.body: A gymnast since the age of 8, I discovered the circus arts at 18. Since then, I have built a stage career that combines athletic discipline with an actor's presence, across some of the world's most ambitious productions.

disciplines.title: Disciplines
disciplines.subtitle: Three core stage specialties, complemented by a wide range of mastered apparatus. Click on a highlighted card to watch the video.

items.bungee_straps_desc: Signature act at La Perle by Dragone — creation of the bungee straps act for ECHO by Cirque du Soleil.
items.banquine_desc: Team acrobatic lifts — trust, timing and collective flight.
items.acrobatics_desc: Floor acrobatics, tumbling and airtrack — the gymnastic foundation built over fourteen years of practice.

ka.title: KÀ by Cirque du Soleil
ka.desc: House troupe for KÀ, Cirque du Soleil's permanent show at the MGM Grand. Specialised in stunt and floor acrobatics acts within one of the most ambitious and technically complex productions in the world.

laperle.title: La Perle by Dragone
laperle.desc: World-renowned show directed by Franco Dragone. 2 performances per day, 5 days a week. Acts: airtrack acrobatics, bungee straps, banquine, V-Pole. Understudy for the lead character 'Clown Prince' from 2019.

imaginacie.title: Imaginacie Festival
imaginacie.desc: Creation of a flying trapeze act with Cirque Évasion for the international Imaginacie festival.

asterix.title: Parc Astérix
asterix.desc: 4 seasons as an acrobat and actor. Creations with Jean-Claude Cotillard: 'Fear at the Park' (Gargoyle role), 'The Legion Recruits', 'Gauls vs Romans — The Match'.

pierre.title: Pierre & Vacances
pierre.desc: First stage experience: circus entertainer, flying trapeze lessons for children and adults, weekly shows.

contact.subtitle: A production, an event, a training session?
